Menṭha,[‡] and that the", "end": "space"}, {"n": 11, "text": "verses quoted by Dr. Aufrecht as Bhartṛimenṭha’s,[§] to judge", "end": "space"}, {"n": 12, "text": "from their beginning as given by him, do not belong to any", "end": "space"}, {"n": 13, "text": "work, that I am aware of, ascribed by tradition or any other", "end": "space"}, {"n": 14, "text": "authority to Bhartṛihari. Mr. Sashagiri’s story, however,", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "has no reference to this exalted rank of Chandragupta.
